messages:
Alex (Growth): Heads-up — putting together a cohorted onboarding drip that also seeds our benchmark webinar invite. Need quick alignment on segments, cadence, and 2 subject-line variants. Can we lock this today?
Sam (Content): +1. Proposed segments: 1) New signups (0-3 days), 2) Light trial users (3-14 days, <30% feature usage), 3) Power trial users (3-14 days, >30% usage). Each gets different lead magnet + narrative.
Nina (Demand Gen): Those segments look good. For webinar invites I recommend sending to segments 2 & 3 only — segment 1 gets nurture first then invite on day 10 if still active.
Maria (Designer): I can do a modular header for the email that swaps CTA and image per segment. Do we have hero images for the benchmark vs launch stories?
Alex (Growth): We have 2 hero options: benchmark chart (png) and product-in-action illustration. Use chart for power users, illustration for others. Maria — can you export 600x200 and 1200x400 variants?
Maria (Designer): Yep. Will drop assets in the campaign folder by EOD.
Sam (Content): Draft subject lines — A/B test these: 
```
A: See how your peers cut inference cost by 3x — webinar invite
B: Live: Benchmarking inference performance + ask-me-anything
```
Sam (Content): Preheader ideas: 'Quick 30-min walkthrough + Q&A' and 'Benchmarks, configs, and real numbers'.
Nina (Demand Gen): Recommendation: use A for segment 3 (power users) and B for segment 2. Audience size estimate: segment 2 ~4.2k, segment 3 ~1.1k. We should aim for a 2:1 send split to preserve testing power.
Alex (Growth): Good call. Cadence proposal: 
- Day 0: Welcome (everyone)
- Day 3: Segmented product tips + benchmark highlight (segments 2 & 3)
- Day 7: Webinar soft-invite (segments 2 & 3)
- Day 10: Reminder + stronger social proof (segment 3 gets case study)
- Day 14: Last-chance invite / offer recording for others
Sam (Content): For the Day 3 benchmark email, include a short one-paragraph narrative: 'Customers reduced per-token cost by swapping to Redwood Optimize + quantized model runtimes' — then link to a short benchmark blog. Keep the CTA 'See the numbers'.
Maria (Designer): Noted. Any constraints on plain-text fallback? Some ESPs strip background images on small clients. I'll provide a plain header as well.
Alex (Growth): Yes include plain text; important for deliverability. Also, can we add a small experiment: add a second CTA button that routes power users to a 'dedicated capacity' landing page, others go to 'hosted API' doc. Nina — can you confirm the dedicated-capacity landing URL?
Nina (Demand Gen): Confirmed: /dedicated?utm=drip_benchmark. Will share full tracked links in the sheet.
Sam (Content): Quick checklist for send: subject variants locked, preheaders, hero assets, tracked CTA links, audience export, and content QA. I can prepare the copy for each segment and paste into the campaign CSV.
Alex (Growth): Who's owning the QA on send day?
Maria (Designer): I can do a visual QA.
Nina (Demand Gen): I'll do list checks and spam-filter passes (seed list + Litmus).
Sam (Content): I'll do copy QA and link verification.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: campaign-qa-check in 2 days at 10:00 AM (PST).
Alex (Growth): Perfect. Action items: Sam — copy by EOD tomorrow; Maria — assets by EOD today; Nina — link sheet and audience exports by tomorrow morning. I'll assemble the campaign and schedule a 15-min QA sync for send day. :thumbsup:
Nina (Demand Gen): Added to calendar. Any objections to sending the webinar invite to APAC at 10:00 PST (evening APAC) or should we stagger?
Sam (Content): Stagger slightly — send APAC window at 22:00 PST for better open rates, schedule in two waves.
Alex (Growth): OK plan: NA/EU send in primary window, APAC in a later wave. Thanks team — let's reconvene in QA sync if anything blocks.
